biotools.summary: Leonardo is an AI-powered toolbox for light-sheet microscopy image processing, correcting for sample-induced aberrations such as stripe artifacts and optical distortions. The toolbox includes modules for de-striping and image reconstruction, providing a graphical user interface and model code for easy application.
biotools.name: Leonardo
